name: idea-vault
description: Summarize ideas discussed in ChatGPT, maintain idea and discussion summaries, and save or resume them through an existing GitHub connection only on explicit user request.

interface.shortDescription: アイデアをGitHubに保存・再利用
interface.longDescription: Summarize ideas and discussions into idea.md and discussions.md. On explicit request, save, update, search, and resume ideas using the user's existing GitHub connection. No additional MCP server is required.
